title: Sum 1 to n
prompt: sum_to(n) should return 1 + 2 + ... + n. sum_to(3) returns 3 instead of 6.
starter:
def sum_to(n):
    # sum_to(3) -> 1 + 2 + 3 = 6
    # Tip: list(range(1, 3)) is [1, 2].
    total = 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        total += i
    return total
hints: Print each i inside the loop for n = 3.
explanation: range(1, n) excludes n, so the last number was never added. The stop value must be n + 1.
